items.title: What Is Oracle (ORCL) Building With Its New AI And Quantum Deals?
items.summary: Oracle (NYSE: ORCL) extended its long term collaboration with Amazon Web Services to help enterprises run Oracle AI Database workloads on AWS. The companies aim to accelerate cloud adoption for large enterprise customers by making Oracle services more accessible on AWS infrastructure. Quantinuum entered a partnership with Oracle to deliver hybrid quantum computing services through Oracle Cloud Infrastructure. items.title: New Study Reveals Strongest State Economies, Only 1 State Was Better Than Texas
items.summary: CNBC's 20th annual state business rankings handed the overall crown to Ohio for the first time ever, but in the critical economy sub-category it was a two-state race: North Carolina led the nation and Texas came in second, even as the Lone Star State carries more foreign investment than any other top-10 economy in the country.

items.title: Ellison Is Now Willing to Sell CNN to Save His $111 Billion Deal. It Wouldn’t End the Lawsuit.
items.summary: David Ellison is dangling CNN to appease critics of his massive Warner Bros. Discovery deal, but the attorneys general suing to block it say the offer solves nothing. A September deadline and a seven-figure daily fee are forcing a decision that no single concession can fix.
